scope: agent-to-agent delegation lifecycle between two loopback Nodes with real Pi

environment.agents: pi-a on mac-a, pi-b on mac-b (pi 0.83.0 through pi-acp 0.0.35), MCP bridge active
environment.model: a DeepSeek Flash model served by a local gateway

results.check: continue a delegated session with its session_id
results.detail: second mesh_send reused the same child session: turns 2, context retained, no second approval, parent returned the child's answer

results.check: cancel the parent while the child runs
results.detail: parent cancelled at 20 s, the child kept running its 60 s command and finished with CHILD-done; nothing tells the parent's owner that a child is still running

results.check: peer disappears while the parent waits
results.detail: mac-b stopped mid-delegation; the parent session was still running with no error after 150 s; after restart the child was idle with an empty final; only a manual stop recovered the parent

a session opened from another computer may only call agents on that computer, so A to B to C is impossible and A to B to A is rejected; the error is English policy text and the agent improvised options for the owner
the child waited in pending_approval on B, the parent waited, approval on B returned APPROVAL-child-ok; on A the owner saw only a spinning parent with no hint that B was asked to approve

remaining: an agent can still retry a dead peer on its own after the tool error; ending that loop needs a turn budget or watchdog, which is not implemented
the remote copy close only applies while it is still busy; an idle mirror stays as last seen
fixes: cancelling or closing a parent cancels the sessions it delegated to a peer (link recorded when mesh_send opens one)
an interrupted agent process is reported as a cancelled turn, not an error, when the owner asked to stop
mesh_wait and mesh_get_session return a clear 'lost contact' error instead of waiting forever
remote session copies close after two failed refreshes (~60 s) instead of staying busy
cross-computer delegation is explicitly one hop: remote agents are hidden from a session another computer opened, with a clear error

every turn has a time budget (default 30 min, HMESH_TURN_BUDGET_SECONDS overrides): on expiry the turn is cancelled, the agent is ended after 10 s if needed, and the turn ends as timeout with a clear error
verified: cancel propagation: parent cancelled, child on the peer stopped within ~10 s as a clean cancelled turn
one hop: the existing delegation test still passes; the error names the one-hop limit
unit/workspace tests and strict clippy pass after the changes
turn budget: with a 6 s budget, a 30 s tool turn ended in 11 s as stop_reason=timeout with the budget error
